postconditions.expression: all(char in input_string for char in output)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output is present in the input string.

postconditions.expression: len(output) == sum(1 for char in set(input_string) if input_string.count(char) % 2 != 0)
postconditions.description: The number of characters in the output is equal to the number of characters that appear an odd number of times in the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(input_string.rindex(char) == input_string.index(char) for char in output)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output is the last occurrence of a character that appears an odd number of times in the input string.
